trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied query may open a file or URL is decided once for the whole DuckDB pool at engine-configuration time (allowed_directories + enable_external_access=false inside configureDatabase), not per request by the SQL-text denylist in the query handler; the published fix installs that lockdown as the last step of database.New and keeps imports/delete-staging/profile output inside the allowlist.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says authenticated users read arbitrary local files through DuckDB I/O functions while bypassing RBAC table checks, so an engineer first looks at the only in-code user-SQL guard: the read_parquet()/arc_partition_agg() denylist inside ValidateSQLRequest, which the POST /api/v1/query, /query/msgpack, /query/arrow and /query/estimate handlers all call.

fix_sites.entry_point: database.New — reached by every authenticated query route (library layer; new internal/database/sandbox.go)

POST /api/v1/query with x-arc-profile:true (profile JSON output file, fix.diff:995)
POST /api/v1/query/arrow with x-arc-profile:true (profile JSON output file, fix.diff:1099)
POST /api/v1/import/csv and /api/v1/import/parquet (multipart upload staging dir, fix.diff:596)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report blames the handler's SQL denylist, so the engine layer looks like someone else's concern: embedders and the compaction worker open their own DuckDB handle (internal/compaction/subprocess.go:97) and were never subject to this package's configuration.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multipart CSV/Parquet import stages the upload in os.TempDir() and then runs COPY ... TO a parquet file beside it through the same pool, and DELETE on S3 backends stages its rewritten parquet the same way; an over-broad enable_external_access=false with an allowlist that does not include those staging dirs (and the DuckDB spill/profile dirs) breaks every import, every S3 DELETE and profile mode with a permission error.

O6_input_shapes: whole DuckDB I/O table-function family, not just read_parquet: read_csv_auto, read_csv, read_json, read_json_auto, read_text, read_blob, glob, parquet_metadata, parquet_schema, read_xlsx (fix.diff:1357-1376)
remote schemes http:// and https:// including link-local metadata IPs (SSRF) (fix.diff:1393-1404)
write sinks: COPY ... TO a local path, COPY ... TO 's3://attacker-bucket/...', EXPORT DATABASE (fix.diff:1406-1437)
extension-loading shape: INSTALL/LOAD after the flip, and SET GLOBAL enable_external_access=true at runtime (fix.diff:1439-1453)

operator path shapes feeding the allowlist: relative vs absolute, leading/interior double slash, trailing slash, '..' prefix, symlinked ancestors, Unicode control/format/line-separator characters (fix.diff:142-204, fix.diff:1690-1740)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v1/query/:measurement — the where= query parameter is spliced verbatim into the SQL after only validateWhereClauseQuery (blocks ';', comments and DDL/DML keywords but allows SELECT, parentheses and any table function), then executed on the same pool; 'where=1=(SELECT count(*) FROM read_text('/etc/passwd'))>0' is not filtered by the read_parquet denylist and the rewriter leaves table functions untouched.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: internal/api/query.go:3391-3419 (validation at :3392, string build at :3413-3419, execution at :3444; table-function skip at :2054-2063)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a convenience read endpoint with its own hand-rolled WHERE validator, not the /api/v1/query API the report names, so a solver treats it as already covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~1500 lines below the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/v1/continuous_queries (+ PUT, + POST /:id/execute, + the cron scheduler) stores a raw user query in SQLite and later executes it via h.db.Query with only {start_time}/{end_time} substitution — ValidateSQLRequest is never called at write or at run time.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: internal/api/continuous_query.go:290-294 (store), internal/api/continuous_query.go:475-489 (substitute), internal/api/continuous_query.go:704 (execute), registered at internal/api/continuous_query.go:233-238
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Continuous queries are admin-only (auth.RequireAdmin) and run from a scheduler rather than the query API, so a solver argues the caller is already privileged and the route is a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file in the same package; the executing code sits ~400 lines from the stored definition and in a different process path (scheduler)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second convenience read endpoint (e.g. GET /api/v1/query/:measurement/filter or a measurements-search route) that splices a caller-supplied WHERE/ORDER BY fragment into SQL with the same small keyword list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already ships exactly this pattern and its validator is a local slice, so a maintainer adding a filter variant would copy it verbatim

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a scheduled report / materialised-view feature that persists user SQL in SQLite and runs it from the cron scheduler
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: continuous queries already store free-form SQL and re-execute it with string substitution, so a sibling scheduled-SQL feature is the natural next PR

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another engine-output path that writes a file from DuckDB (EXPLAIN/ANALYZE dump, cache export, query-plan capture) using os.CreateTemp("")
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: two independent profile writers already did this at the pinned commit, so a third output writer is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second in-repo DuckDB opened with sql.Open that never goes through configureDatabase (the compaction worker, and the `arc compact` subcommand path)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the published fix explicitly notes this process is not subject to the sandbox, so a maintainer adding another out-of-process worker would repeat it

O9_family: CWE-200/CWE-22/CWE-918 — arbitrary local-file read and SSRF through untrusted SQL reaching DuckDB I/O functions

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend the ValidateSQLRequest denylist regex in internal/api/query.go to also block read_csv_auto/read_json/read_text/glob and the other names from the report, leaving the engine open to the rest of the I/O family and to the routes that never call the validator.

out_of_scope_notes: internal/compaction/subprocess.go:97 opens its own DuckDB with sql.Open outside database.New, so the sandbox never applies there; it takes no user SQL and was left alone.
unverified: No build or test was run (read-only screening, no shell); buildability and offline behaviour are inferred from go.mod, go.sum, Makefile and Dockerfile.
Repository size in MB could not be measured without a shell; repo_mb is null and neither tiny_repo nor giant_repo was asserted.

The GET /api/v1/query/:measurement where-clause shape was reasoned from the rewriter's table-function skip (internal/api/query.go:2054-2063) and the validator's keyword list (internal/api/query.go:641-658); it was not executed.
